title: Gate A: box and look diff, ours against the oracle, report in parity/gate-a.json
gate: npm run gate: 27/39 on oracle-turn-1040; zero cases fails; a lower count fails unless --accept
evidence: scripts/gate.mjs + scripts/oracle/collect.mjs (one instrument both sides) + app/src/routes/gate.$state.tsx; parity/gate-a.json Box cases (task-9350f7d5eee2c573, scripts/lib/box-cases.mjs): every box of 20x20 or more outside the conversation that paints and that no named case scores. Paints means the capture shows it drawing: a background colour that is not clear, a background image, a top border that shows, a box-shadow, an img, an svg that holds a drawn part (a path, shape, use, text or image the capture kept: an empty svg is what a broken icon looks like), or text of its own. A paintless wrapper is no case: its box comes from what it holds. A fill or top border paints only if, laid over what is behind it (the ancestors' backgrounds on the page's own background), it moves the pixel by 4/255 or more in some channel: a perception floor, not a number from a capture. So a 0.06 white hairline on rgb(18,18,18) paints (14) and a 0.01 fill or a fill the colour already behind it does not (2, 0). Behind unknown, so not scored: the oracle's captures predate the page's background (collect.mjs page), so a box of theirs that would paint only by a fill or top border and has no opaque ancestor is laid over a colour the capture does not hold. No colour is guessed: it is no case, the box of ours it pairs with is no extra, and the gate prints it as Unscored. There are 16, in 9 states, each a page-level modal backdrop (presentation 0,0 1040x760) or dialog: oracle-connect-apps, oracle-get-mobile, oracle-new-bot-dialog, oracle-settings, oracle-settings-computer, oracle-settings-permissions and oracle-settings-updates (backdrop and dialog), oracle-picture-viewer and oracle-picture-viewer-rest (dialog). They come back when the oracle is recaptured with page. One count is lower on purpose (gate --accept, round 3 on #328): oracle-connect-apps 146 → 142. Six box cases that passed are no case now: its backdrop and dialog (behind unknown, above) and four 20x20 avatar rings under Your plugins (box:control:Your plugins › span#1-#4 at 767.7,102 to 809.7,102), each filled and top-bordered rgb(31,31,31) inside the rgb(31,31,31) dialog, so they move no pixel over what is behind them in the DOM. Known blind spot: behind means the ancestors only. The rings are stacked 14 apart, so each one's edge lies over the avatar before it, where it does show; a sibling drawn under a box is not in the model. Two cases pass that did not (box:page › header#1, box:page › div#1: page-wide pairing). A second is lower on purpose (round 3 cut): oracle-new-bot-dialog 119 → 118. box:control:heart character shape › span#1, Grok's 46x46 selected tile (rgba(245,245,245,0.22)), had passed by its centre against our 36x36 svg glyph; judged by its box it fails, box off by 5,5,-10,-10, because we draw no selected tile. No case changed for the empty-svg rule: every svg on both sides holds a drawn part. Known blind spot: the capture keeps no outline, no side or bottom border, no ::before/::after and no mask, so a box drawn only by those reads as paintless and is never scored. No box is scored twice: a named element (its box and look), its own box again, a box at the place of one already kept, the transcript's time row, the conversation (its articles, its log and the boxes that hold it: transcript and card cases) and an svg's parts are left out. Each box of the oracle's pairs with one of ours anywhere on the page, one to one, best overlap first: which named element holds a box is DOM nesting, not where it is drawn, so it never scopes the pairing. The floor is any overlap at all (IoU > 0): boxes that share no point are not one box. A pair passes within 1 pt on every edge, box only (its look is a later step). A text-less <i> is an icon glyph, drawn by a font or pseudo-element the capture cannot see: it paints and, as the oracle's box, is scored as an svg is (task-fe5a057a7e4b05b7). A box painted only by its top border is that line: it pairs by the strip it draws and passes on its two ends and its top edge, within 1 pt; a line need only be 20 long. The oracle's menu separators (account menu, between its groups at 431, 509.5 and 622) are in no captured element, so our two group lines there stay extra: a known blind spot. An svg of the oracle's pairs the same way but passes on its centre alone, within 1 pt, never its size: an svg's box is its viewBox, padding and all, and the capture keeps no ink, so where its drawing ends inside the box is a known blind spot (task-992182d31333922a). Only the oracle's: a box of the oracle's with a known size is judged by its box even when ours is an svg (round 3 cut: our 36 svg glyph had greened Grok's 46 selected tile). The capture keeps no fill or stroke, so an svg part drawn with neither still counts as drawn: a known blind spot. A box of the oracle's with no partner fails as missing, and a painted box of ours with none fails as extra, so either reds only itself and moves no other pairing (check 'box cases'). A hover state scores only what it changed, so it has none. Card parts (scripts/lib/cards.mjs) pair the same way, within their kind: best overlap first, one to one, IoU > 0, never by order, so one part shifted or one too many reds only itself (task-fe5a057a7e4b05b7). Recorded 2026-11-25 by a real run: 499/530 pass over 33 states, and no case outside the box and card cases moved from main; card parts paired by overlap turned 2 card cases green (card#1 box#7 in oracle-main-720 and oracle-main-790), and none red. Per state: oracle-account-menu 13/16; oracle-ask-choice 12/12; oracle-choice-answered 12/12; oracle-composer-menu 13/13; oracle-connect-apps 29/38; oracle-edit-avatar 38/38; oracle-file-sent 12/12; oracle-file-waiting 14/14; oracle-get-mobile 13/15; oracle-language-picker 13/13; oracle-library 8/8; oracle-main-1000 12/12; oracle-main-1280 12/12; oracle-main-1600 12/12; oracle-main-2000 12/12; oracle-main-720 12/12; oracle-main-790 12/12; oracle-main-800 12/12; oracle-main-820 12/12; oracle-main-880 12/12; oracle-main-980 12/12; oracle-new-bot-dialog 37/40; oracle-panel-closed 6/6; oracle-picture-viewer-rest 18/19; oracle-picture-viewer 18/19; oracle-pictures-sent 12/12; oracle-pictures-waiting 17/18; oracle-settings-computer 17/20; oracle-settings-permissions 15/16; oracle-settings-updates 13/13; oracle-settings 17/24; oracle-turn-1040 12/12; oracle-voice-picker 20/20. Named misses, measured with no app change (task-029b8bea1606ff62, from a --ci dump of our 54 captures): (1) Grok capture artifacts, 59 cases in oracle-main-720, -790, -1280, -2000 and oracle-choice-answered: the oracle's list is virtualized (a 5560-tall content box, rows placed by measured height), and the width captures were taken after a resize. At 720 and 790 the user bubble re-wrapped to two lines (120, 62 tall) while the last turn kept its old place (160), 22 over it; ours lays them end to end, so all above sits 22 higher (the last turn matches to the point: 160, 862). At 1280 and 2000 the oracle kept its scroll across the resize, its last row 66 and 242 above its end; our pinned list cannot sit above its end without a spacer only the gate draws. Pinned (oracle-file-sent) and at 1000 both sides match. (2) Placeholders: the settings descriptions (oracle-settings-computer 3, oracle-settings-permissions 1, oracle-settings p#1) wrap exactly as the oracle's (315,194 485x36 at 13/18 both sides), but ours holds placeholder bars, not the oracle's copy text, so its span paints nothing of its own and the case is missing. (3) Product differences: oracle-pictures-waiting's alert (ours caps a message at four pictures and files, Barkpark's limit, and says so when five wait); oracle-settings-updates' "You're up to date" (a placeholder: nothing checks for updates, so nothing may claim it) and its version (ours shows our build's version, not 1.2.3, so Version is 30.2 wider and bdi:1.2.3 reads missing). (4) Pictures we have no real content for: the oracle's app logos in oracle-connect-apps (Browserless, incident.io, Turso, Lightrun, Knock, Google Drive, Your plugins, Bot templates), oracle-settings' hero, icons and profile photo, and oracle-get-mobile's QR code and logo; no stand-in is drawn. (5) The time row (oracle-file-sent, -pictures-sent, -pictures-waiting, up to 2.1 off and 4.1 wider): no spacing is fitted to changing text. (6) Reminders' glyph in oracle-connect-apps is drawn by tiny spans, so our 24 svg there stays extra.
